tagline.en: Chicago to the Mississippi, downstate Illinois end to end
tagline.zh: 自芝加哥至密西西比河，纵贯伊利诺伊南部

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: I-55 and US 60 at Sikeston, Missouri
start.zh: 密苏里州赛克斯顿，与 I-55、US 60 相接

end.en: I-94 (the Dan Ryan Expressway) in Chicago, Illinois
end.zh: 伊利诺伊州芝加哥，与 I-94（丹·瑞安快速路）相接

en: I-57 exists to let traffic between Chicago and the lower Mississippi valley avoid St. Louis. It leaves I-55 at Sikeston in the Missouri bootheel, runs east to Charleston, turns northeast across the Mississippi River at Cairo, and then goes almost straight north for the length of Illinois to the south side of Chicago.

Between the two ends it is a rural road through mostly farmland and small county seats — Marion, Mount Vernon, Effingham, Mattoon, Champaign, Kankakee — picking up heavy truck traffic where it overlaps I-64 at Mount Vernon and I-70 at Effingham. In Chicago it becomes the Dan Ryan Extension, and unusually for a Chicago expressway it is referred to by its number rather than a name.

Since 2017 the number has also been attached to an unconnected freeway in Arkansas, where US 67 northeast of Little Rock has been redesignated I-57 in anticipation of an eventual link north to the Missouri section.
zh: I-57 的存在，是为了让往来芝加哥与密西西比河下游的车流绕开圣路易斯。它自密苏里靴跟地区的赛克斯顿离开 I-55，东行至查尔斯顿，再折向东北于开罗跨过密西西比河，随后几乎笔直北上，纵贯伊利诺伊全境抵达芝加哥南部。
两端之间，它是一条穿行于农田与小县城之间的乡村道路——马里恩、弗农山、埃芬厄姆、马通、香槟、坎卡基——在弗农山与 I-64 共线、在埃芬厄姆与 I-70 共线处则接收大量货运车流。进入芝加哥后它成为丹·瑞安延伸线；与芝加哥其他快速路不同，人们习惯以编号而非名称称呼它。
自 2017 年起，这个编号还被挂到阿肯色州一条互不相连的高速公路上：小石城东北的 US 67 已被改编为 I-57，以备日后北接密苏里路段。

en: The first Illinois section was dedicated on 26 September 1961: thirty miles from Dongola north to Marion. The road was pushed north in short increments — Johnston City in November 1962, West Frankfort in 1963, Mount Vernon by 1965 — and then in a rush through 1969, when Illinois opened segments at Ullin, Mattoon, Arcola, Tuscola, Salem, Onarga and Rantoul in the same year.

Chicago's end began with 1.1 miles west from the Dan Ryan and Calumet expressway junction to Halsted Street, opened on 6 November 1963. The remaining urban segments came in phases between 1967 and 1970.

The last piece of the whole corridor was the Mississippi River crossing. I-57 ended at US 60 and US 62 outside Charleston, Missouri, until the steel through-arch bridge at Cairo was dedicated on 23 June 1978, six years after construction started, opening the eleven-mile link that joined the Missouri and Illinois halves.
zh: 伊利诺伊首段于 1961 年 9 月 26 日落成：自东哥拉北上至马里恩，全长三十英里。此后道路以小段递进的方式北推——1962 年 11 月到约翰斯顿城，1963 年到西弗兰克福，1965 年前抵弗农山——随后在 1969 年集中放量，该年伊利诺伊在乌林、马通、阿科拉、塔斯科拉、塞勒姆、奥纳加和兰图尔同时开通多个路段。
芝加哥一端始于 1963 年 11 月 6 日通车的 1.1 英里，自丹·瑞安与卡卢梅特快速路交汇处西至霍尔斯特德街。其余市区路段在 1967 至 1970 年间分期建成。
整条走廊最后完成的是跨密西西比河段。在开罗的钢系杆拱桥于 1978 年 6 月 23 日落成之前，I-57 一直止于密苏里州查尔斯顿外的 US 60 与 US 62；该桥自开工历时六年，通车后打通了连接密苏里段与伊利诺伊段的十一英里路段。

en: No total was ever compiled for I-57. What is on record instead is a long series of individually reported projects, which is how most Interstate spending is actually documented: the Cairo bridge and its approach link in the 1970s, and then four decades of widening.

The larger recent items are the rebuild of the shared I-57 and I-70 pavement at Effingham, and the six-laning of the southern end around Marion, which also brought southern Illinois its first diverging diamond interchange.

In Arkansas the designation has become a funding argument in itself. Congress created Future I-57 along US 67 in 2016 and AASHTO approved it in 2017; Arkansas has since won federal grant money for bypass construction north of the existing freeway, on the strength of the corridor eventually reaching Missouri.
zh: I-57 从未汇总出总造价。留下记录的，是一长串各自公布的单个项目——这也正是绝大多数州际公路支出的实际记载方式：1970 年代的开罗大桥及其接线工程，此后是长达四十年的拓宽。
近年较大的项目，是埃芬厄姆 I-57 与 I-70 共线路面的改建，以及南端马里恩一带的六车道拓宽；后者还为伊利诺伊南部带来了第一座「分离式菱形立交」。
在阿肯色，这个编号本身已成为争取资金的理由。国会于 2016 年沿 US 67 设立「未来 I-57」，AASHTO 于 2017 年批准；此后阿肯色凭借该走廊终将北接密苏里的前景，已为既有高速公路以北的绕城段争得联邦拨款。

value.en: 380.90 miles — Illinois 358.57 and Missouri 22.33; the route log separately lists 108.30 miles of I-57 in Arkansas, a later designation not physically connected to the main route
value.zh: 380.90 英里，其中伊利诺伊 358.57、密苏里 22.33；路线登记表另列阿肯色境内 108.30 英里 I-57，属后来的编号，与主线并无实体连接

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

label.zh: 开罗跨密西西比河大桥

value.en: $25.4 million over six years of construction, opened as part of a $50 million, eleven-mile link from Charleston, Missouri, to US 51 outside Cairo — the last section of the corridor to open
value.zh: 历经六年施工，造价 2,540 万美元；作为自密苏里州查尔斯顿至开罗外 US 51 之间、造价 5,000 万美元的十一英里连接段的一部分通车，是整条走廊最后开通的路段

label.zh: 埃芬厄姆 I-57／I-70 改建

value.en: $125 million to widen the shared section to six lanes, replace the Little Wabash River bridge and rebuild the Fayette Avenue interchange; ground broken 5 October 2010 and finished in autumn 2016
value.zh: 1.25 亿美元，用于将共线段拓宽至六车道、更换小沃巴什河桥并重建费耶特大道立交；2010 年 10 月 5 日动工，2016 年秋完工

figures.source: Effingham Daily News, September 2012 and October 2015

label.zh: 马里恩一带拓宽与立交工程

value.en: $10.6 million to widen I-57 to six lanes between Marion and Johnston City, broken ground 16 July 2013; a separate $40 million project built southern Illinois's first diverging diamond interchange, opened 12 August 2015
value.zh: 1,060 万美元用于将马里恩至约翰斯顿城之间的 I-57 拓宽至六车道，2013 年 7 月 16 日动工；另有 4,000 万美元项目建成伊利诺伊南部首座分离式菱形立交，2015 年 8 月 12 日开通

figures.source: Illinois Government News Network, 15 July 2013; The Southern Illinoisan, 12 August 2015

label.zh: 阿肯色科宁绕城线拨款

value.en: $24.9 million federal RAISE grant awarded to ARDOT on 3 February 2025 for a four-mile bypass on the Future I-57 corridor
value.zh: 2025 年 2 月 3 日，阿肯色州交通部获 2,490 万美元联邦 RAISE 拨款，用于「未来 I-57」走廊上四英里的绕城线

figures.source: Arkansas Department of Transportation press release, 3 February 2025

why.en: No agency publishes a route-wide figure. Counts are collected per segment by Illinois and Missouri, and on the overlaps with I-64 at Mount Vernon and I-70 at Effingham the traffic cannot be attributed to I-57 alone.
why.zh: 没有机构发布全线数字。交通量由伊利诺伊与密苏里分段采集；在弗农山与 I-64、埃芬厄姆与 I-70 的共线段上，车流无法单独归于 I-57。

value.en: 15,000 vehicles a day in 2024, of which about half are trucks
value.zh: 2024 年日均 15,000 辆，其中约半数为货车

value.en: 4,090 feet long with an 821-foot main span, built 1978, rated in fair overall condition with a superstructure rating of 5 and a stable, low scour risk
value.zh: 全长 4,090 英尺，主跨 821 英尺，1978 年建成；整体状况评为「一般」，上部结构评级 5，冲刷风险稳定且较低

timeline.en: The first Illinois section, thirty miles from Dongola north to Marion, is dedicated on 26 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 26 日，伊利诺伊首段落成：自东哥拉北上至马里恩，全长三十英里。

timeline.en: The first Chicago portion opens on 6 November, 1.1 miles west from the Dan Ryan and Calumet expressway junction to Halsted Street.
timeline.zh: 11 月 6 日，芝加哥首段通车：自丹·瑞安与卡卢梅特快速路交汇处西行 1.1 英里至霍尔斯特德街。

timeline.en: Illinois opens segments at Ullin, Mattoon, Arcola, Tuscola, Salem, Onarga and Rantoul in a single year.
timeline.zh: 伊利诺伊在一年之内于乌林、马通、阿科拉、塔斯科拉、塞勒姆、奥纳加和兰图尔开通多个路段。

timeline.en: The last of the Chicago urban segments opens, completing I-57 within the city.
timeline.zh: 芝加哥市区最后一段通车，I-57 在市内全部建成。

timeline.en: The Mississippi River bridge at Cairo is dedicated on 23 June, joining the Missouri and Illinois halves and completing the corridor.
timeline.zh: 6 月 23 日，开罗跨密西西比河大桥落成，接通密苏里段与伊利诺伊段，整条走廊贯通。

timeline.en: AASHTO approves Future I-57 along the US 67 freeway in Arkansas on 24 September, a year after Congress created the designation.
timeline.zh: 9 月 24 日，AASHTO 批准阿肯色境内沿 US 67 高速公路设立「未来 I-57」，此前一年国会已设定该编号。

timeline.en: ARDOT posts the first of more than 1,400 I-57 signs along US 67 on 17 March.
timeline.zh: 3 月 17 日，阿肯色州交通部沿 US 67 竖起 1,400 余块 I-57 标牌中的第一块。
